transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm Grace Okafor, existing patient. By the way my insurance changed to Cascade Health.
Thanks, Grace, I've noted that. May I have your date of birth?
Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM, Wednesday at 2 PM, or Friday at 2 PM.
Booked: Grace Okafor, Monday at 10 AM. A confirmation will be sent. Goodbye.
